itens.titulo: Gold rises over 1% as dollar weakens, Treasury yields retreat
itens.descricao: Gold rises over 1% as dollar weakens, Treasury yields retreat Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Spot gold rose 1.1% to $4,177.83 per ounce by 22:40 ET (02:40 GMT), while U.S.
The dollar's rally paused, making gold cheaper for holders of other currencies, while the benchmark 10-year U.S.

Louis Federal Reserve President Alberto Musalem said on Thursday that further monetary tightening would be needed to bring inflation back to the central bank's 2% target within a reasonable timeframe.
Traders were pricing in an 18% probability of a rate hike in October and an 82% chance of an increase in December, according to the CME FedWatch tool.
Oil prices remained a key risk for bullion, with Brent crude climbing above $104 a barrel amid concerns over Middle East supply disruptions.
Among other precious metals, silver rose 1.7% to $60.19 an ounce, while platinum gained 2.1% to $1,678.15/oz.
